text:
Nora: Heads-up — Brightling reported 4 failed charges this morning. Declines show 'BIN_BLOCK' from the acquirer. They tried two cards and ACH fallback failed. Can someone take a look?
Alex: On it. Do you have charge IDs / customer account so I can pull full logs?
Nora: Brightling acct: brightling-inc. Charge IDs: ch_01GXA9..., ch_01GXB2...; last4 4242 and 4005 (both Visa). Gateway response includes 'bin_restricted' and acquirer_code=899.
Sam: Noted. I've seen similar when an acquirer blacklists a BIN range. Priya, can you check routing tables and gateway responses?
Priya: Looking now. Quick glance: gateway shows acquirer a1 returning bin_restricted. I can push a temporary route to acq-b for this customer to retry, pending compliance sign-off. ETA ~20m.
Nora: Customer is in danger of service interruption. Can we offer immediate wire instructions as a fallback while you route? Legal/Finance ok with sending wire details?
Alex: We have a standard wire template. Finance (Kasia): can you approve manual settlement and waiving any late fees if they pay by wire?
Kasia: I can approve waiving fees for this week. For wires, we need remittance and billing contact confirmation before marking as paid.
Nora: Copying Brightling contact in DM. Sam — can you send the bank details template to the customer and request confirmation? I'll prepare the internal note.
Sam: Will do. Also recommending we change the retry schedule for this account: retries at 6h and 24h, then stop further card attempts if BIN_BLOCK persists. Alex, can billing service accept that patch?
Alex: Yes. Patching billing-service now: setting retries [6h, 24h] and adding fail_reason tag 'BIN_BLOCK' to halt after 3 attempts. Pushing prod change in 5m.
Priya: Routing change deployed to acq-b for 6% of this account's traffic. Initial results: 1 success, 2 failures so far. Monitoring dashboard: https://monitoring.redwood/payments/brightling-inc
Nora: Customer agreed to interim wire. Sam include this in the message: 'If you'd like to pay by wire, please reply with proof of payment/remittance and we will mark invoice as settled.'
Sam: Sent to customer. Created support ticket Zendesk #8742 — https://zendesk.redwood/tickets/8742 
PaymentsBot: Routing change: acq-b rollout for brightling-inc (6%) — results: 1 success, 2 failures.
Alex: When the wire arrives, what's the ops flow to mark invoice paid so we don't retry card?
Kasia: Finance ops: once we receive remittance and funds clear, we set invoice.status = 'settled-wire' and close the invoice, then cancel pending retry jobs. Please attach payment confirmation to the Zendesk ticket.
Priya: Update: success rate improving — 3/4 passed on acq-b after bump. Keeping rollout throttled to observe for 24h.
Nora: Thanks all. Quick operational notes: include this incident in the payments retro and add BIN ranges to our test harness. Also, follow-up with acquirer to understand why the BIN was blocked.
Sam: Quick commands I used to pull logs: `curl -s "https://payments.redwood/api/v1/charges?customer=brightling-inc&status=failed" | jq .`
Alex: Good idea to add unit to test harness. Also adding a mute policy so we don't hammer the gateway while routing changes propagate.
Nora: Wire template I sent to customer (internal copy):
```
Bank: First Republic Bank
Account name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Account #: 123456789
Routing (ACH): 021000021
SWIFT: FRBKUS6L
Reference: Brightling-Invoice-INV-8872
```
Kasia: Received. Finance will watch for remittance and mark settled once cleared.
PaymentsBot: Note: continue monitoring. Alert thresholds set to 5 failed attempts within 12h for brightling-inc.
Priya: Will follow up with acquirer support ticket and share their response here.
Nora: OK closing loose ends — Sam will update Zendesk with any remittance, Alex will confirm billing patch deployed, Priya will post acquirer response, Kasia will confirm settlement when wire hits.
Sam: Updated ticket and noted waiver.
Alex: Billing-service patch live.
Priya: Opened acquirer support case #ACQ-5591.
Kasia: I'll notify finance ops to expect remittance.
Nora: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
